text: Typed-null PR (#6506) incoming: VARTYPE(x,.T.) / TYPE() for NULL fields (VFP9-probed on 10 field types), PrgValue gains null_declared_type. The issue assumed VFP9 does not skip NULLs in aggregates; probing shows it does (SUM/AVG/MIN/MAX skip NULL, COUNT(field)=non-null count, COUNT(*)=records), so that part of the issue text is wrong. I also fixed two things the check exposed: SQL COUNT(field) was error 1127 after the statement-condition change (regression of mine, now counts non-NULL values), and CALCULATE CNT() returned 0. Filed #6738: CALCULATE with an expression list + variable list assigns wrong values. Queue: #6737 (numeric equality + REPLACE digits, rebased), then typed-null, then MDY/DMY.
